note: The two sets are essentially identical: both cover the same nine drivetrain properties from Table 5-1 and the body text, with the same values, units, quotes and conditions (including the free-free-mode damping condition and the FAST/ADAMS no-friction-loss condition). The only difference is how the brake torque claim is phrased — A puts 'fully-deployed' in the attribute name while B keeps it as an explicit condition — and both are faithful to the source. Both sets also contain the same harmless duplication (each fact stated once at component level and once at turbine level), so neither gains an advantage.
